categories.main_business_segments: Chongqing Millison Technologies INC. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of aluminum alloy precision die-castings for the communication and automotive sectors. Its communication products include 4G and 5G base station structural components such as housings and shielding covers. Automotive products cover traditional vehicle engine, transmission, steering, and body system components, as well as new energy vehicle electric drive, control, battery systems, and body structural parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high vacuum die casting, precision machining, mold design and manufacturing, high thermal conductivity and lightweight materials, chromium-free surface treatment, electrostatic powder spraying, friction stir welding, laser welding, brazing, and refrigerant filling. It has developed integrated casting technologies for large structural parts and proprietary high thermal conductivity alloys, maintaining international-level capabilities in these areas.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading communication equipment manufacturers and major automotive OEMs and first-tier suppliers, covering Japanese, American, European, and emerging Chinese new energy vehicle makers such as NIO, Rivian, SAIC, XPeng, and battery manufacturers. The company serves the communication base station market and the automotive market, including traditional and new energy vehicles, with a focus on lightweight and integrated aluminum alloy components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in Chongqing, Xiangyang, Dongguan, Ma'anshan, and is constructing a North American facility. Its sales cover domestic China markets and overseas regions including the United States, Estonia, Mexico, India, Poland, Germany, and France. The overseas sales accounted for approximately 24% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Millison operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and processing of aluminum alloy precision die-cast components. It provides full-process solutions from mold design and manufacturing to casting, machining, surface treatment, assembly, and testing, serving as a key supplier to communication equipment manufacturers and automotive OEMs and suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in integrated casting technologies, high-performance aluminum alloys, lightweight and high thermal conductivity materials, and advanced joining techniques like brazing and friction stir welding. It focuses on innovation for 5G and next-generation communication infrastructure, new energy vehicles, and digital energy markets. Strategic priorities include expanding overseas production, enhancing digital and intelligent manufacturing, and deepening collaboration with key customers for customized product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized aluminum alloy precision die-cast components to communication and automotive customers. The company operates on a build-to-order basis, with sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. Additional income sources include leasing, government subsidies, and investment income, but product sales constitute the vast majority of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Millison is positioned as a leading domestic player and manufacturing champion in the aluminum alloy precision die-casting industry in China. It holds a competitive edge in high vacuum casting and integrated casting for large structural parts, with recognized technological leadership and strong customer relationships. It is among the few companies capable of providing full-process solutions for 5G base station components and automotive lightweight parts, competing with both domestic and international suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.66 billion, a 14.73% increase over 2023, with automotive parts revenue growing 46.31% while communication parts declined 19.86%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 163.8 million, reflecting increased expenses and impairment losses. Total assets reached RMB 7.13 billion, up 25.11% year-over-year, indicating ongoing expansion and investment in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Millison emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop solution capability from mold design to final assembly, advanced high vacuum and integrated casting technologies, and proprietary high thermal conductivity aluminum alloys. Its products offer superior precision, lightweight, thermal management, and structural performance, meeting stringent requirements of 5G communication infrastructure and new energy vehicles. The company’s close collaboration with leading global customers and continuous innovation provide differentiated value and strong market competitiveness.
